implementation.code_change: AsKnownReplaySnapshotService.php: added public const REASON_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE = 'REASON_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE'; 'reason_registry_hash' now returns this marker unconditionally. $reasonIdentity/'reason_registry_identity' context entry left in place as harmless descriptive context, never itself claimed as an identity.

implementation.defect: verifyAsKnownAgainstFixture() had no admissibility check for this marker; it would compare against fixtures and could reach PASS/MISMATCH/FAIL on a fabricated basis.
implementation.old_source: ReplayVerificationService::verifyAsKnownAgainstFixture() proceeded directly from the empty-hash check into AsKnownReplayExecutionService::execute().
implementation.code_change: ReplayVerificationService.php: inserted an early-return block, placed BEFORE the execution service is invoked (unlike PUBLICATION_EXACT's admissibility check, which runs AFTER the actual state is built, because AS_KNOWN's canonicalizer has real side-effect/expense concerns and running it would contradict 'the comparison did not execute'). Fires when $actualSnapshot['reason_registry_hash'] === AsKnownReplaySnapshotService::REASON_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE. Builds and persists a BLOCKED/NOT_ADMISSIBLE metric directly from the captured snapshot: admission_state=NOT_ADMISSIBLE, comparison_result=NOT_ADMISSIBLE, replay_status=BLOCKED, status=HELD, publishability_state=NOT_READABLE, publication_id=null, source=as_known_replay, mismatch_count=0, mismatches_json=[], mismatch_summary carries a human-readable REPLAY_REASON_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE: <explanation> string.
implementation.resulting_behaviour: every as-known replay is BLOCKED before any comparison executes, unconditionally -- no fixture content can reach comparison, because the block fires on the captured snapshot alone, independent of what the fixture claims.

implementation.defect: storage boundary accepted a non-BLOCKED result carrying the fabricated hash, checking only for emptiness.
implementation.old_source: ReplayResultRepository::assertModeInputs(): both-modes loop treated a non-empty reason_registry_hash as present.
implementation.code_change: ReplayResultRepository.php: added an explicit check ahead of the both-modes loop -- a non-BLOCKED metric whose reason_registry_hash equals AsKnownReplaySnapshotService::REASON_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE is refused with RuntimeException, in both replay modes.
implementation.resulting_behaviour: a direct write cannot bypass the service-layer BLOCKED decision by constructing its own non-BLOCKED metric carrying the marker.

final_reason_code_design_decision.initial_attempt: the BLOCKED metric's final_reason_code was first set to the bare literal 'REPLAY_REASON_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE'.
final_reason_code_design_decision.discovery: the first full isolated regression (2467 tests, 8 failures) found one real, new failure: EmittedReasonCodeRegistrationTest::test_every_reason_code_emitted_by_the_runtime_is_registered -- a static+seed-execution scan (not a hand-written list) proving the literal was emitted by ReplayVerificationService.php but registered in neither Reason_Codes_Seed.sql nor Reason_Codes_Registry.md. This is a genuine defect this unit introduced, not a false positive: an operator reading this code out of eod_run_events/eod_replay_results would find nothing to look it up in.
final_reason_code_design_decision.authority_boundary_found: Reason_Codes_Registry.md is registered in MARKET_DATA_STRATEGY_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json as strategy_id MD-S085 with a pinned sha1 under the current freeze (MD-STRATEGY-FREEZE-20260922-001). An attempt to add the code there and to the paired Reason_Codes_Seed.sql (kept synchronized with the registry by LoggingTraceabilityReasonCodesStaticGuardTest::test_reason_code_registry_and_seed_are_synchronized) caused two further regression failures: GovernanceGateReadOnlyExecutionTest's STRATEGY_FREEZE check (sha1 mismatch on the frozen document) and its TRACEABILITY_MATRIX check (twenty 'source mismatch MD-S085-R####' errors from inserting a row that shifted every positionally-derived requirement id below it). The one prior precedent for adding a code to this exact document (DOC-CHG-20260823-001 / D-MD-20260823-01, BAR_ZERO_VOLUME_PRICE_MOVEMENT) required an explicit, quoted user authorization instruction before any byte of the frozen document changed, plus a successor freeze manifest and a DOCUMENT_CHANGE_LOG.md entry. This unit's governing instruction authorized Gap B2's production remediation; it did not authorize amending a LOCKED strategy-authority document, and 'Do not start G01-B' signals the user wants strict scope discipline.
final_reason_code_design_decision.reverted: both edits (Reason_Codes_Registry.md, Reason_Codes_Seed.sql) fully reverted via exact-line Edit (git checkout was refused by the harness's own destructive-action classifier, so the inserted lines were removed individually instead). Reason_Codes_Registry.md's sha1 reconfirmed identical to the frozen manifest's registered value (3BB61139B60926D99A7E0940636A830C99627030). The one row seeded into tradeaxis_testing.eod_reason_codes during the attempt was deleted, restoring the table to its prior 437-row count.
final_reason_code_design_decision.final_design: final_reason_code is set to null in this early-return block instead. Precedent: replayAdmissibility()'s own NOT_ADMISSIBLE override (Gap A's CONFIG_IDENTITY_UNRECORDED path, and REPLAY_BOUND_INPUT_INCOMPLETE/REPLAY_CONFIG_UNBOUND generally) never assigns a bespoke final_reason_code either -- those block-reasons live only in the free-text 'reason'/mismatch_summary field, which is exactly why they were never caught by this same scan (the regex requires the quoted string to be the bare code with nothing else, and 'CODE: explanation text' does not match). AS_KNOWN's early return has no regular field comparison to inherit a final_reason_code from (by design, the canonicalizer is never invoked), so null is used directly rather than fabricating one. The specific cause remains fully legible via mismatch_summary/comparison_note (the $reason string, which does contain the REPLAY_REASON_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE text) and via reason_registry_hash (the REASON_REGISTRY_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE marker itself, already required to be looked up by predicate/code, not by a registry row). No new reason code was registered; no LOCKED strategy document was modified; no new authorization was required.
final_reason_code_design_decision.verified: with this design, EmittedReasonCodeRegistrationTest, LoggingTraceabilityReasonCodesStaticGuardTest and GovernanceGateReadOnlyExecutionTest (9/9, 5966 assertions, including its self-test's 30-mutation control table) all pass; none of this unit's own new tests assert final_reason_code for the AS_KNOWN BLOCKED case, so no test needed to change.

It creates new replay artifacts and never mutates or impersonates the original publication.'
r0005_impact.original_guard_shape: positive: an as-known result claims no publication and records its own mode (still passes, unmutated). negative (former test_an_as_known_result_diverging_from_its_own_fixture_is_a_mismatch): perturbed the fixture's own snapshot_hash and asserted MISMATCH/FAIL, proving a genuine as-known divergence is caught rather than silently accepted under the 'may differ' permission.
r0005_impact.structural_change: Gap B2 makes every as-known replay BLOCKED before any comparison runs, unconditionally -- confirmed by inspection of AsKnownReplaySnapshotService::capture(): the reason_registry_hash assignment has zero conditional logic capable of ever not returning the unavailable marker. No fixture content can reach comparison through the real verifier any more.
r0005_impact.classification: IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE. R0005's own implementation is not defective and its positive clause remains independently true and reachable. Its negative clause's prerequisite -- a reachable as-known comparison -- is unavailable because a different required input (reason-registry identity) is genuinely unbindable per current authority, not because R0005 itself is unimplemented.
r0005_impact.action_taken: per instruction, not force-replaced with a same-named guard proving a different claim. The renamed test at the old name (test_an_as_known_result_with_a_diverging_fixture_is_still_blocked_by_the_unavailable_reason_registry) proves a true and useful but different fact (BLOCKED regardless of fixture divergence), not R0005's own original negative claim. MD-S050-R0005 moved from PROVEN to INCOMPLETE in the proof basis: positive clause kept unchanged, negative set to null.
r0005_impact.remediation: none available within this unit's authority; would require real historical reason-registry versioning (explicitly out of Gap B2's scope) or an owner decision narrowing R0005's own required proof shape.

r0014_r0071_review.MD-S019-R0071: reviewed independently of R0014, as instructed. What Gap B2 does prove is the narrower, adjacent Platform_Config_Registry_LOCKED.md:291 guarantee (current state must never leak into historical replay) for this ingredient specifically, confirmed by test_mutating_the_current_reason_registry_does_not_make_as_known_admissible. That is real and proven, but not R0071's own claim. Remains INCOMPLETE; basis text extended accordingly.
